image_prompt: Jervas Dudley is a young man in his mid-20s, with a tall, slender build and an unnervingly intense gaze. His features are sharp and angular, with a prominent brow, sunken cheeks, and piercing eyes that seem to peer directly into the viewer's soul. His pale, almost sallow skin is offset by a mane of wild, dark hair that falls in disheveled waves around his face. Jervas wears a high-collared, velvet-trimmed frock coat of a deep, midnight blue, giving him an air of brooding sophistication. There is an unsettling quality to his demeanor, a sense of barely contained energy and a hint of the occult that clings to him like an aura of mystery.
